capabilities.body: OpenAmer wuxuu qorsheeyaa hawl, wuxuu ku fuliyaa qalab dhab ah — khadka amarrada, biraawsar, faylal, koodh — wuxuuna xafidaa wixii shaqeeyay.
capabilities.title: Kaaliye kula fikira

capabilities.body: Wada sheekaysiga, xusuusta iyo moodelladu waxay ku jiraan kombiyuutarkan. Waxba lama geliyo internetka ilaa aad codsato.
capabilities.title: Qalabkaaga, xogtaada

capabilities.body: 186 luqadood, mid walba farta aad dhab ahaan akhrido. Shaashadda koowaad ee abka ayaa ku weydiinaysa midda aad rabto.
capabilities.title: Luqaddaada, si sax ah

capabilities.body: Xirfadaha waxaa laga kaydiyaa shaqada lafteeda, sidaas darteed hawlaha maalinlaha ahi way soo gaabtaan mar kasta oo aad isticmaasho.
capabilities.title: Awood sii kobcaysa

help: Hubi in kombiyuutarkani geli karo internetka.
Mar kale socodsii dejinta — tallaabooyinka dhammaaday laguma celinayo.
Haddii ay laba jeer fashilanto, fur diiwaannada; sadarrada ugu dambeeya ayaa sheegaya tallaabada.
failure.lead: Wax isbeddel ah si qarsoodi ah looma celin — OpenAmer wuxuu ku hakadaa halkii uu joogay, sidaas darteed socodsiinta xigta ayaa halkaas ka sii wadaysa.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer weli wuxuu ku jiraa noocii hore wuuna shaqaynayaa. Waxba nus ahaan looma beddelin.
failure.title: Dejintu ma dhammaan

language.lead: Dejintu waxay ku sii soconaysaa luqadda aad halkan ku doorato. Mar dambe ayaad abka ka beddeli kartaa.
language.title: Dooro luqaddaada

progress.lead: Dejin hal mar ah: OpenAmer wuxuu soo dejinayaa waxa uu u baahan yahay, wuxuuna habaynayaa kombiyuutarkan. Furitaannada dambe intaas oo dhan way ka boodaan.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer wuxuu beddelayaa noocii hore. Fadhiyadaada, xusuustaada iyo dejimahaaga lama taabanayo.
progress.stepsComplete: {done} ka mid ah {total} tallaabo ayaa dhammaaday
progress.title: Dejinta OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Rakibidda oo loo calaamadinayo inay dhammaatay
stages.dependencies: Rakibidda waxyaabaha Python ku tiirsan yahay
stages.node-deps: Rakibidda waxyaabaha Node.js ku tiirsan yahay

cards.body: Fur abka oo sharax waxa aad rabto in la qabto. OpenAmer wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa gadaal, dabadeedna wuu kuu soo sheegaa.
cards.title: Ku bilow jumlad

cards.body: Dejimaha → Muuqaalka → Luqadda. 186 luqadood iyo deegaan, waadna beddeli kartaa wakhti kasta.
cards.title: Dooro luqaddaada

cards.body: Shaqada soo noqnoqota waxay noqotaa xirfad — marka xigta waxay u baahan tahay hal amar.
cards.title: U oggolow inuu xusuusto

success.command: ama mar dambe ka bilow khadka amarrada:
success.lead: Wax walba waa diyaar. OpenAmer hadda adigaa leh — kombiyuutarkan, luqaddaada.
success.title: OpenAmer waa diyaar

bullets: Wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa kombiyuutarkaaga — wada sheekaysigaagu halkan ayuu joogayaa
186 luqadood, oo ay ku jirto farta aad akhrido
Wax walba mar dambe waa la beddeli karaa; wax joogto ahi ma jiraan
welcome.leadUpdate: Nooc cusub oo OpenAmer ah ayaa diyaar ah. Wuxuu beddelayaa noocii hore, wuxuuna ilaalinayaa fadhi iyo dejin kasta.
welcome.note: Waxay qaadanaysaa dhowr daqiiqo haddii xiriirku caadi yahay.
welcome.title: Ku soo dhowow OpenAmer
